title: Solutions Architect, New Business, EMEA
Impact Producer
description: About ElevenLabs  ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.  We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.  We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:    ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.    ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.    ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.    Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.    How we work     High-velocity:  Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.     Impact not job titles:  We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.     AI first:  We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.     Excellence everywhere:  Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.     Global team:  We prioritize your talent, not your location.      What we offer     Innovative culture:  You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.     Growth paths:  Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.     Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.     Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.     Annual company offsite:  Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.     Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.     About the role   The ElevenLabs Impact Program exists to democratize access to our technology and make AI work for all people, supporting for-good use cases across healthcare, education, and culture. Today, some of our work includes providing free and discounted access to nonprofits, partnering with university professors to bring voice AI into the classroom and the research lab, and working to restore the voices of one million people living with permanent voice loss through our 1 Million Voices initiative (learn more at  elevenlabs.io/impact ). We're looking for a Producer to own the external storytelling and event presence for Impact, a role that coordinates PR, agency management, social launches, documentary-style case studies, and event production. This is a hands-on, in-house role: you're the person who makes sure every launch, film, and activation meets (or, ideally raises) the bar of the rest of the company's output, working closely with our internal Design, Comms, and Events teams, and, when applicable, with the external agencies and production teams supporting PR, film, and creative execution. As Impact's first dedicated producer, you'll build the production and launch engine for a team whose external footprint is scaling fast, this quarter alone includes 5+ events, six documentaries in production, two live ElevenLabs Summit sessions, a partner launch every month, and several more case studies in flight.    What you'll do     Coordinate production of Impact's documentary case studies: travel and work onsite for filming when needed, work closely with external production and direction teams, bringing opinions on story and craft, and partner with our Design team to make sure every film meets ElevenLabs' bar and brand guidelines.    Plan and execute Impact's conferences and activations alongside the Events team, turning each one into an in-person moment that drives real ROI and leaves a lasting impression, with Impact's own storytelling angle built in.    Support Comms in telling Impact's story through PR, coordinating with Comms and, when applicable, a PR agency to keep press windows and partner announcements on track, and helping make sure Impact's international stories get told well as the program expands globally.    Partner with Design to keep all video and static collateral on-brand, advocating for a high creative standard and Impact’s lens.    Carry a consistent visual and narrative thread across launches, blog content, and ElevenLabs Summit presentations.    Draft copy for social and blog content, collaborating with Comms to land a final draft, and with Design on all launch-related visual assets.    Manage multiple concurrent launches, shoots, and events at once.      Requirements     A great project manager with a sharp creative eye, someone who runs cross-functional logistics flawlessly, has real taste, and will push the team to hit it.    Organized and detail-oriented, with a track record of juggling several production timelines at once.    Creative or production background (agency, marketing, in-house brand/content team, documentary or branded content) comfortable being on set and in the room with Design, not just commissioning the work.    Strong writing and visual taste; can tell when something is on-brand and polish-worthy.    2-5 years of experience in production, events, or brand marketing.    Comfortable traveling for shoots and events.      #LI-Remote  We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
